content: He who can govern his own senses like a tortoise withdrawing its limbs into its shell has built a fortress of lifelong protection. (Kural 126)
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation:
In the Sangam masterpiece of the Tirukkural, Thiruvalluvar provides a universal ethical compass for integrating righteous duty (*Aram*), practical prosperity (*Porul*), and enduring human nobility.

This passage emphasizes the vital importance of govern and senses in human life. By moving beyond superficial distractions and grounding attention in timeless ethical principles, we cultivate inner stability, clarity of thought, and genuine resilience.

True realization is never an abstract academic debate—it is an active discipline practiced through conscious daily choices and unwavering integrity.
